title: clusia engleriana
intro: Clusia engleriana, commonly known as the Panama hat plant or Clusia, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Clusiaceae family. It is valued for its leaves, which have been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The health benefits of Clusia engleriana include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Clusia engleriana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
